description: Creates or updates one relay in Development from gemmein/relays/<name>.json's contents ({ name, trigger, actions }); explain_relay validates the same definition offline. A signing or receiver secret Gemmein makes for it is not returned here — the answer carries the dashboard link where the founder sees it once. A relay is what a founder may describe as 'when X happens, do Y'.
name: put_relay
title: Save a relay
